title: Please drop architecture dependent *.mo files from git
author: petterreinholdtsen
body_preview: The src/oscar/locale/*/LC_MESSAGES/django.mo files are machine specific (depend on the installation machine endianness).  This mean they should be generated during build and installation of the program.  Because of this, I recommend dropping them from git, to avoid breaking installation on big endian machines.
